index.html.heading: Długosz software downloads
index.html.description: Download Launcher and Shared Updater Client for Windows x64.
body: Downloads for Windows x64. Browse all files and previous versions.
Open apps and files from tabs along the edge of your screen.
Check for updates and install new versions of Launcher and other Długosz apps.

launcher/1.1.0.24/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.24 Beta
body: Clicking Launcher while its About dialog is open brings the dialog forward.
Extract the ZIP and run Install.cmd, or choose Install… in Shared Updater Client.

launcher/1.1.0.26/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.26 Development
body: This build uses the shared Windows C++ modules for file lookup, About, and the Updater handoff. About shows whether Launcher is portable, installed for all users, or installed for your Windows account.
In Launcher, choose About → Check now, follow the development track, and choose Install… for this version.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install from the download, extract it and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.27/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.27 Development
body: Setup records the committed update so Updater Client 1.0.16 can verify and open the post-update review. Registered Release Setup retains a verified prior executable when available.
In Launcher, open About → Check now, follow development, and choose Install… for this build.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.33/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.33 Development
body: Setup adds Launcher Update History and Recovery to the Start menu for the selected installation scope. Updater Client 1.0.17 can verify the committed update and open a review after Setup.
In Launcher, open About → Check now, follow development, and choose Install… for this build.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.34/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.34 Development
body: Setup’s Finish page shows where to find Launcher Update History and Recovery when its Start shortcut is available.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.35/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.35 Development
body: Setup has a more compact Finish page, its own Windows taskbar identity, and a Launcher icon. The page shows where to find Launcher Update History and Recovery when its Start shortcut is available.
Launcher passes the TOML parser’s line and column to Updater when invalid settings prevent startup.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.37/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.37 Development
body: Setup records the signed archive identity for a later Revert. This package establishes the baseline for reverting from a subsequent signed build.
Launching with no arguments reveals the existing default drawer, including after Hide. Launching with an explicit configuration opens a separate drawer.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.39/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.39 Development
body: Reinstalling the same Launcher build now preserves its verified archive history when the installed program and managed files still match. This keeps the previous signed package available for Revert.

The bundled Launcher SVG Extractor now has its own version. Its product version is 1.1 and its file version is 1.1.0.38. Future Launcher builds can keep the same Extractor when its code and resources are unchanged.
With Updater Client 1.0.23 and Launcher 1.1.0.37 installed through the catalog, update to this build to try restoring the exact previous signed package.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Install.cmd.

launcher/1.1.0.40/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.40 Development
body: Launcher Setup has its own signed executable for the install and upgrade elevation prompt. Windows Installed apps also opens Launcher Setup to uninstall.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Launcher Setup.exe in the versioned folder.

launcher/1.1.0.41/index.html.heading: Launcher 1.1.0.41 Development
body: Launcher Setup has its own signed executable for the install and upgrade elevation prompt. Windows Installed apps also opens Launcher Setup to uninstall.
Download the Launcher development ZIP. To install manually, extract the complete archive and run Launcher Setup.exe in the versioned folder.

launcher/examples-1.1.0.23/index.html.heading: Launcher Example Panels
body: • Everyday pairs Windows shortcuts with a Projects panel you can customize.
• Many Colors previews the bundled light colors across 21 tabs.
• Adobe Creative Cloud illustrates discovery of installed Adobe applications.
Extract the ZIP to a folder you can edit and follow README.txt to open a sample in Launcher. Prerelease evaluation terms are included.

launcher/index.html.heading: Launcher portable downloads
body: • Extract the complete ZIP to a folder you can write to.
• Read Portable.txt and open the versioned folder beside it.
• Run the versioned Launcher-R<version>.exe directly. The outer Install.cmd is for installing Launcher.
To give this copy its own settings, copy Launcher.default.toml to
Launcher.toml beside the executable before first run.

previous-versions/index.html.heading: Previous versions
previous-versions/index.html.description: Browse the public Launcher and Shared Updater Client download folders.
body: Open a version folder to download its files. Select index.html for release notes where available.

shared-updater/1.0.12-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.12
shared-updater/1.0.12-prerelease/index.h.title: Shared Updater Client 1.0.12 | Długosz
body: The Updater now discovers publisher-defined tracks, remembers durable tracks, and shows tracks ending in * only while they are offered.
Close the Updater window before running Setup. An upgrade keeps your existing installation scope. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
This development build is signed with the Długosz prerelease certificate. Use it on a test PC configured to trust that certificate.

shared-updater/1.0.13-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.13
shared-updater/1.0.13-prerelease/index.h.title: Shared Updater Client 1.0.13 | Długosz
body: • The catalog groups Launcher, Updater Client, and related downloads in separate sections.
• The list marks installed and older versions and remembers related files you downloaded through the Updater.
• Eligible newer Updater packages offer Install… and keep your existing installation scope.
If you are upgrading from 1.0.12, choose Download… in the Updater, then close that window and run the saved Setup.
This development build is signed with the Długosz prerelease certificate. Use it on a test PC configured to trust that certificate.

shared-updater/1.0.14-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.14
shared-updater/1.0.14-prerelease/index.h.title: Shared Updater Client 1.0.14 | Długosz
body: • Set how often the app checks for updates next to Follow track. The defaults are 30 days for release, 7 for beta, and 1 for development or a special track.
• The wider Track and Status columns make labels such as Downloaded before easier to read.
• Hover over any column in a package row to see its details. The tooltip stays visible longer.
In Updater 1.0.13, select 1.0.14 and choose Install…. Windows needs to trust the prerelease signer for this handoff. You can also choose Download…, close the Updater, and run the saved Setup.
This development build is signed with the Długosz prerelease certificate. Use it on a test PC configured to trust that certificate.

shared-updater/1.0.15-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.15
shared-updater/1.0.15-prerelease/index.h.title: Shared Updater Client 1.0.15 | Długosz
body: • Updater Setup asks Windows to bring it forward during a manual upgrade and flashes its taskbar button if Windows declines. The new Updater also hands foreground permission to Setup and lets the open Launcher About window yield where needed.
• Hover over the information icon to see that it shows the Updater Client version and packages.
In Updater 1.0.14, select 1.0.15 and choose Install…. Windows needs to trust the prerelease signer for this handoff. You can also choose Download…, close the Updater, and run the saved Setup.
This development build is signed with the Długosz prerelease certificate. Use it on a test PC configured to trust that certificate.

shared-updater/1.0.16-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.16
body: Launcher recovery can open the package catalog even when Launcher cannot start. The catalog offers Skip build and Allow build for automatic update selection. Verified Launcher upgrades can open a review after Setup.

shared-updater/1.0.17-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.17
body: After a verified Launcher update, the review shows the installation time in Windows local time. Keep this version acknowledges the update and closes the review. Review later leaves the decision pending.

shared-updater/1.0.18-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.18
body: The update notice is bold. Product Setup runs with its console hidden when launched from Updater Client.

shared-updater/1.0.19-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.19
body: Product Setup opens without allocating a console when launched from Updater Client.

shared-updater/1.0.20-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.20
body: Updater monitors Launcher’s first start after a verified update with Launcher 1.1.0.34 Setup. It displays Launcher’s settings diagnostic when the settings file prevents startup. A slow start offers more time, and an unexpected early exit can offer recovery.

shared-updater/1.0.21-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.21
body: When Launcher’s settings prevent startup after a verified update, Edit opens the reported file at the TOML error in registered Notepad++. Windows Notepad is available if Notepad++ is absent. After correcting the file, Start again retries the failed launch. A successful retry opens the update review.

shared-updater/1.0.22-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.22
body: Updater Setup waits for brief review-status checks to finish before starting an in-app upgrade. Updater also distinguishes its own executable from other programs named Updater.exe.

shared-updater/1.0.23-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.23
body: Revert can restore a previously installed Launcher from its exact signed catalog archive, including changed companion files, while preserving your settings. The installation history must record both signed archives.

shared-updater/1.0.24-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.24
body: Automatic all-users upgrades show the Setup window before requesting administrator approval. The signed bundle uses the Shared Updater Client Setup name for its elevation handoff.

shared-updater/1.0.25-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.25
body: Automatic all-users upgrades show the Setup window before requesting administrator approval. The signed bundle uses the Shared Updater Client Setup name for its elevation handoff.

shared-updater/1.0.27-prerelease/index.h.heading: Shared Updater Client 1.0.27
body: When Launcher starts an update, Shared Updater Client Setup shows the Długosz Launcher name and icon and explains why it opened. The window title reads “Shared Updater Client Setup.”

shared-updater/index.html.heading: Shared Updater Client
shared-updater/index.html.title: Shared Updater Client | Długosz
shared-updater/index.html.description: Install the update checker shared by Launcher and other Długosz apps for Windows.
body: Launcher and other Długosz apps use the same updater to check for new versions. Once installed, it opens when you choose Check now in an app’s About window.
Previous versions and all Shared Updater Client files

• Open the downloaded Setup program. Choose All users if your app was installed for all users, or Just me if it was installed for your Windows account. An upgrade keeps the scope of the existing updater.
• Setup downloads and installs the Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime if needed. Windows may ask for administrator approval.
• When Setup finishes, return to your app’s About window and choose Check now.
